REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - OCTOBER 28, 2004 - CITY HALL -
7:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Presentations
6.
Employee Service Awards
5A.
Consideration of Appointments to Vacancies on Various Commissions, Boards and Committees. Consideration of appointment to the Community Safety Committee
7.
Public Comments and Suggestions
Consent Calendar
8.
Registers of Demands dated 10/28/2004
9.
Treasurer’s Reports for period ending 9/30/2004
10.
Minutes of 10/14/2004
11.
Ordinance for second reading and adoption. Reading of ordinance waived and ordinance adopted
11A.
Ordinance No. 888 – An ordinance of the City of Cerritos amending Title 22, Chapter 22.94, Sections 22.94.050 and 22.94.060 of the Cerritos Municipal Code increasing the art in public places fee from one-half of one percent to one percent and decreasing the applicable project valuation from $350,000 to $250,000
12.
Miscellaneous
12A.
Approval of First Amended Joint Exercise of Powers Agreement for the Orange Line Development Authority
End of Consent Calendar
13.
Public Hearings
13A.
Appeal to the City Council PPC 2004-3 – An appeal of a decision of the Cerritos Property Preservation Commission denying a request to remove a parkway tree adjacent to the property located at 11313 Yearling Street, Cerritos, California (APN 7050-005-017) – Case No. TR 2004-5 – Appellant: Mark Chen, Ph.D.
13B.
A review of the Natural Hazards Mitigation Plan as required by the Federal Emergency Management Agency. A
resolution of the City Council of the City of Cerritos adopting the Natural Hazards Mitigation Plan
13C.
An ordinance of the City of Cerritos amending Title 9 of the Cerritos Municipal Code by adding Chapter 9.90 entitled loitering by criminal street gangs
13D.
Cerritos Redevelopment Agency Conformity Report 2004-6/Mitigated Negative Declaration/Conditional Use Permit 2004-4/Precise Plan 2004-15, 12657 166th Street, APN 7010-016-053
13E.
Consideration of recommended expenditures for 2004 Local Law Enforcement Block Grant Funding allocations
14.
Pending Legal Matters/Resolutions for consideration
14A.
Consideration of City/Agency option to receive shares of tax increment in accordance with the provisions of Health and Safety Code Sections 33607.5 and 33607.7. A joint resolution of the City Council of the City of Cerritos and the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency electing to receive shares of tax increment for existing projects amended to increase project limitations, pursuant to Health and Safety Code Sections 33607.5 and 33607.7
15.
Public Works Activities
15A.
Consideration and award of a contract for the rehabilitation of the C-2 well at 16540 Marquardt Avenue, APN 7016-012-902, Project 363.001, Bid No. 980-05.
16 New and Old Business
16.
New and Old Business
16A.
Consideration of a field dedication request in memory of Craig Willig.
17.
Report on Pending Legislation
18.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports
19.
Closed Session
19A.
Conference with legal counsel – existing litigation (Subdivision (a) of Government Code Section 54956.9) Name of case: August Construction v. Cerritos Redevelopment Agency et al. Case No. Los Angeles Superior Court Case No. VC038662
20.
Adjournment
